description: Instant pre-trade safety check for any of the 18 FX, Gold (XAUUSD / GOLD) & Silver (XAGUSD / SILVER) pairs (broker suffixes like EURUSD.pro or XAUUSDm normalized automatically). Returns boolean prop_safe_to_trade (enforces T-5m PRE_NEWS blackout, 5m post-release Restricted News Window, and Whipsaw/Collision/Foreign Noise/Toxic Window VETO shields), directional bias (BUY | SELL | NEUTRAL), wait_seconds countdown, and standardized surprise_z. EUR/USD works live with zero key (30 req/min); optional FNR_API_KEY unlocks Gold & all 18 pairs (240 req/min).

prop_account.description: True (default) enforces strict prop-firm T-5m pre-news and 5m post-release Restricted News Windows (FTMO, FundingPips, The5ers). False checks raw directional liquidity safety only.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol (e.g. "XAUUSD", "GOLD", "EURUSD", "GBPUSD", "USDJPY", or broker symbol like "EURUSD.pro"). Defaults to "EURUSD".
